lede: The biggest item this week is Monday's joint HARC and P&Z special session on wildfire resiliency code amendments — proposed changes to Telluride's Land Use Code and Design Guidelines that will shape how the town builds and retrofits going forward, with Town Council getting the final vote. Thursday brings the Telluride Hospital District board's mill levy discussion, a perennial pressure point as the hospital pushes toward a new facility. The week also has the Shandoka Lot redevelopment getting its first real P&Z look, and the Open Space Commission working through the Perimeter Trail NEPA process and other active projects.

notable.stake: Wildfire code amendments to Town Land Use Code head toward Council vote.
Hospital District discusses mill levy — the tax mechanism funding operations and new facility.
Major Town-owned Shandoka redevelopment gets first P&Z feedback before formal review.
NEPA update and Perimeter Trail progress — public land decisions moving forward.
